items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: So the Michael Jackson “Off the Wall” stuff was $500 a chart, a tune.

ctx.x: Michael Jackson in a couple of instances. David Foster in a couple of instances, who also has perfect pitch and keyboard perfect pitch which is kind of crazy that he can listen to a song one time and play it back to you. Really amazing. And he’s also wonderful in the studio, just a brilliant musical mind. And he would sing some things. This is back in the day, not everybody’s got a demo and you kind of play what the demo is.
So did you always have score paper with you?
